purpose: Source-scoped, machine-readable future acceptance vectors, not executable Phase2 Verify, not OEM signoff.

authority.nonInterchangeableModels: FCV-588 only; do not import FCV-38/600/800/1900 UI or glossary

executionPolicy: FUTURE_TEST_VECTORS_ONLY; all cases NOT_EXECUTED. Do not edit/run affected Verify while Kongming gate remains unresolved.

fields.sourceLimit: Source-graded training Data/NAV box subset only; OEM field placement/revision and actual receiver behavior unverified.

vectors.title: NAV1/NAV2 four-box selection cancel/commit
vectors.expectedInvariant: Four semantic boxes, ability to return without commit, replay unchanged by cancellation
vectors.qualification: Existing tests touch this; full V31 rerun blocked

vectors.title: Source switch Own→NMEA when receiver absent
vectors.expectedInvariant: Keep selected NMEA but show NO DATA; never borrow Own sample; stored choice survives valid power cycle
vectors.qualification: Requires V31 source-bound end-to-end evidence

vectors.title: Stale/invalid position and negative STW/SOG
vectors.expectedInvariant: Fail closed to NO DATA; do not fabricate bearing, pressure or cross-track error
vectors.qualification: Some synthetic negative tests exist; exact LCD presentation unverified

vectors.title: NAV RANGE and TIME TO GO
vectors.expectedInvariant: Only selected synthetic waypoint+fresh typed ownship+valid positive speed may show an explicitly SIM EST estimate
vectors.qualification: Must not present as manufacturer ETA or ship navigation

vectors.title: Bearing Mag/True, wind Apparent/True and missing field sources
vectors.expectedInvariant: Label choices without converting absent directional values into readings
vectors.qualification: Independent field-specific oracle/fixtures not available

vectors.title: NAV editing during POWER/reset and profile19→20 settings import
vectors.expectedInvariant: No stale pending draft may commit; no replay silently migrates; committed settings only importer remains narrow
vectors.qualification: Requires allowed integrated Verify after STOP lifted

fields.sourceLimit: Only an instructor-declared virtual optional fixture; no installed option, radio link, real partner panel or OEM menu editor.

vectors.title: Declare virtual option then On/Off

vectors.title: Tankenmaru On vs NMEA exclusion

vectors.title: Teacher reset and startup persistence

vectors.title: Virtual details default values

fields.sourceLimit: Offline, receive-status training projection only; physical NMEA electrical, serial, UDP or vessel I/O prohibited.

vectors.title: Baseline receiver absent, NMEA Off
vectors.expectedInvariant: Show missing synthetic source; transport NONE, no physical receiver connection
vectors.qualification: Existing synthetic-only domain tests, not OEM acceptance

vectors.title: Fresh signed-hemisphere coordinates

vectors.title: Stale, future-tick or out-of-range input

vectors.title: Own vs NMEA selected data
vectors.expectedInvariant: Unconnected NMEA selection does not fall back to synthetic Own temperature/trip/speed

vectors.title: Tankenmaru and optional fixture status
vectors.expectedInvariant: Tankenmaru On suppresses NMEA path; Off restores, invalid edits and POWER wrapping cannot resurrect NMEA drafts

vectors.title: No real I/O and replay isolation

vectors.qualification: No live bridge install or hardware connection

fields.sourceLimit: English and Tieng Viet non-diacritic hardware vocabulary from user-authorized 2016 FCV-588 reference photos with §2.4 4-tick reboot on language change; full OEM multilingual ROM table and installed firmware revision remain unverified.

vectors.title: Unsupported locale selection or direct invalid setting injection
vectors.expectedInvariant: Reject arbitrary locale and any fake language migration; preserve known English/Tieng Viet state and storage

vectors.title: User-authorized 2016 Vietnamese FCV-588 vocabulary and reboot persistence
vectors.expectedInvariant: Match non-diacritic hardware strings across menu/choices/NAV and persist committed language across reboot and replay

vectors.title: Public multi-language operator guide existence vs runtime strings
vectors.expectedInvariant: Multilingual guides do not prove additional installed firmware language options beyond authorized reference evidence

mandatoryGlobalInvariants: No actual ship I/O, radio, NMEA transmit, GPS reading or connected sensor is introduced.
No synthetic observation can masquerade as data from real equipment.
No unverified firmware or transducer option is granted by default.
Cancellation, invalid order, POWER wrappers, replay and profile compatibility must remain deterministic.
Keep canonical storage bytes and settings schema18 invariant unless an independently reviewed behavior change explicitly versions them.
Do not treat old V30/31 PASS numbers as a new acceptance receipt or promote any of the 65 claims.
